description: This file defines the AWS ApiGatewayV2Client class used for interacting with the Amazon API Gateway V2 service. It declares a class extending AwsClient and documents various API operation methods with their asynchronous counterparts, facilitating communication with AWS API Gateway.

classes.name: ApiGatewayV2Client
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon API Gateway V2 service, inheriting functionality from AwsClient.
